- **S4** Strain expression is reproducible between replicates
- **S5** Reproducibility improves with cells assigned per strain (A: mean cells, B: min cells)
- **S6** Per-gene expression correlation across strains

YPD (YPD.1 vs YPD.2) and fluconazole (Fluconazole.16 vs Fluconazole.8) only — synthetic complete with glucose and synthetic complete with galactose have one run each.

# Helpers

```{r helpers}
read_pseudobulk <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("File not found: ", path)
  as.matrix(read.csv(path, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, header = TRUE,
                     check.names = FALSE))
}

deseq_normalize <- function(mat, label = "") {
  m   <- round(as.matrix(mat))
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = m,
    colData   = data.frame(row.names = colnames(m), condition = factor(colnames(m))),
    design    = ~ 1
  )
  dds <- tryCatch(estimateSizeFactors(dds),
                  error = function(e) estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts"))
  counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
}

# Per-strain QC from the Seurat object. Metadata only — the object is dropped
# immediately so four of these don't sit in memory at once.
strain_qc <- function(rds_path, replicate) {
  obj <- readRDS(rds_path)
  md  <- obj@meta.data
  rm(obj); gc(verbose = FALSE)

  md %>%
    group_by(strain = SNG.BEST.GUESS) %>%
    summarise(n_cells    = n(),
              median_umi = median(nCount_RNA),
              .groups    = "drop") %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", replicate), -strain)
}
```

# ── Compute ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Removed: cross_mat (full n x n strain pairwise Spearman), diff_r,
# self_rank/n_best, permutation null (N_PERM draws) — that whole block
# only existed to drive the old density-plot S4 (same-strain vs
# different-strain), which duplicates Fig 1 Panel D. Per-strain
# reproducibility (replicate_r) now comes from a single O(n) pass
# instead of an O(n^2) matrix, and feeds both the new S4 scatter labels
# and the existing S5 QC plot — no duplicate correlation computation.

```{r compute}
analyse_condition <- function(cfg) {

  x <- read_pseudobulk(cfg$pb1)
  y <- read_pseudobulk(cfg$pb2)

  reliable <- intersect(rownames(read_pseudobulk(cfg$genes1)),
                        rownames(read_pseudobulk(cfg$genes2)))
  genes   <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(x), rownames(y), reliable))
  strains <- intersect(colnames(x), colnames(y))
  cat("\n---", cfg$label, "---\n")
  cat("Shared strains:", length(strains), "| shared genes:", length(genes), "\n")

  x <- x[genes, strains, drop = FALSE]
  y <- y[genes, strains, drop = FALSE]

  # Per-strain replicate correlation (Spearman is rank-based, so raw
  # counts and log1p(counts) give the identical r — computed once here).
  replicate_r <- vapply(strains, function(s) {
    cor(x[, s], y[, s], method = "spearman")
  }, numeric(1))

  # --- S4: per-strain, per-gene scatter (one facet per strain) --------------
  scatter_df <- map_dfr(strains, function(s) {
    tibble(condition = cfg$label, strain = s, gene = genes,
           val1 = x[, s] + 1, val2 = y[, s] + 1, r = replicate_r[s])
  }) %>%
    mutate(facet_label = paste0(strain, "  (r = ", round(r, 3), ")"))

  # --- S5: per-strain QC ------------------------------------------------------
  qc <- full_join(strain_qc(cfg$rds1, "r1"), strain_qc(cfg$rds2, "r2"),
                  by = "strain") %>%
    mutate(mean_cells = (n_cells_r1 + n_cells_r2) / 2,
           min_cells  = pmin(n_cells_r1, n_cells_r2))

  # Cross-strain r per strain (for the breakpoint plot): median Spearman r of
  # strain s against every OTHER strain across replicates (s rep1 vs t rep2 and
  # t rep1 vs s rep2), same pairs as the Fig 1D cross-strain null.
  cross_mat <- cor(x, y, method = "spearman")      # rows = rep1 strain, cols = rep2 strain
  cross_r <- vapply(seq_along(strains), function(i) {
    median(c(cross_mat[i, -i], cross_mat[-i, i]))
  }, numeric(1))

  strain_df <- tibble(condition = cfg$label, strain = strains, r = replicate_r,
                      cross_r = cross_r) %>%
    left_join(qc, by = "strain")

  cat("Strains with QC data:", sum(!is.na(strain_df$mean_cells)),
      "of", nrow(strain_df), "\n")

  # --- S6: per-gene Spearman across strains (DESeq2-normalized) --------------
  xn <- deseq_normalize(x)
  yn <- deseq_normalize(y)

  gene_r <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(xn)), function(i) {
    suppressWarnings(cor(xn[i, ], yn[i, ], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  }, numeric(1))

  gene_df <- tibble(condition = cfg$label, gene = rownames(xn), r = gene_r) %>%
    mutate(cor_category = case_when(
      r >= 0.7            ~ "high (\u22650.7)",
      r >= 0.4 & r < 0.7  ~ "moderate (0.4\u20130.7)",
      r <  0.4            ~ "low (<0.4)",
      TRUE                ~ NA_character_))

  list(
    scatter_df = scatter_df,
    strain_df  = strain_df,
    gene_df    = gene_df,
    stats      = tibble(condition          = cfg$label,
                        run1               = cfg$run1,
                        run2               = cfg$run2,
                        n_strains         = length(strains),
                        n_genes            = length(genes),
                        median_replicate_r = median(replicate_r),
                        median_gene_r      = median(gene_r, na.rm = TRUE),
                        pct_gene_r_0.4     = 100 * mean(gene_r > 0.4, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

res <- lapply(conditions, analyse_condition)

fct <- function(d) mutate(d, condition = factor(condition, levels = lvl))
scatter_df_all <- fct(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "scatter_df")))
strain_df_all  <- fct(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "strain_df")))
gene_df_all    <- fct(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "gene_df")))
stats_all      <- fct(bind_rows(lapply(res, `[[`, "stats")))

knitr::kable(stats_all, digits = 3)
```

# ── Supplementary Figure 4 ───────────────────────────────────────
# Per-strain replicate scatter grid (raw counts, log-log, one facet per
# strain, r annotated in each facet title) — generalized from the
# original Flu.1-vs-Flu.2-only code to run on both conditions. Replaces
# the old same-strain-vs-different-strain density plot, which duplicated
# Fig 1 Panel D; this version instead gives a reviewer the strain-by-strain
# detail behind Panel D's aggregate claim.

```{r figS4, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2}
make_strain_scatter_fig <- function(df, cond_label) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(condition == cond_label) %>%
    mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = unique(facet_label[order(-r)])))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = val1, y = val2)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.08, size = 0.15, color = condition_colors[[cond_label]]) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    facet_wrap(~ facet_label, ncol = 9) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Per-strain replicate concordance: ", cond_label),
      x     = paste0(conditions[[cond_label]]$run1, " counts (log10, +1)"),
      y     = paste0(conditions[[cond_label]]$run2, " counts (log10, +1)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title    = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text     = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 16, color = "black",
                                   angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
      strip.text    = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines")
    )
}

figS4_YPD <- make_strain_scatter_fig(scatter_df_all, "YPD")
```

# Numbers for the results text (YPD)

```{r text_numbers}
# The saved Seurat objects (Na_va_data_subsetted.rds) already have the
# n_cells > 5 strain filter applied, so a strain with <=5 cells in a replicate
# has NO cells there and its n_cells is NA. NA therefore means "<=5 cells".
ypd <- strain_df_all %>%
  filter(condition == "YPD") %>%
  mutate(le5_cells = is.na(min_cells) | min_cells <= 5)
lo  <- ypd %>% filter(le5_cells)     # <=5 cells in at least one replicate
hi  <- ypd %>% filter(!le5_cells)    # >5 cells in both replicates

cat("YPD strains in both replicates:", nrow(ypd), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Replicate r range: %.3f - %.3f (lowest: %s)\n",
            min(ypd$r), max(ypd$r), ypd$strain[which.min(ypd$r)]))
cat(sprintf("Strains with 5 or fewer cells in a replicate: n = %d, median r = %.3f\n",
            nrow(lo), median(lo$r)))
cat(sprintf("Strains with more than 5 cells in both:      n = %d, median r = %.3f\n",
            nrow(hi), median(hi$r)))
cat(sprintf("\nText: Strains with 5 or fewer assigned cells showed poor reproducibility (n = %d; median r = %.3f, vs. %.3f for strains with >5 cells)\n",
            nrow(lo), median(lo$r), median(hi$r)))

lo %>%
  select(strain, n_cells_r1, n_cells_r2, r) %>%
  arrange(r) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3,
               caption = "YPD strains with 5 or fewer cells in at least one replicate (NA = 5 or fewer, removed before the Seurat object was saved)")
```

# Additional plot — where does reproducibility stop improving with cell number?

Same-strain r (replicate 1 vs 2) and cross-strain r (median against every
other strain) per strain, against cells assigned per strain. A
linear-plateau ("hockey-stick") model is fitted to same-strain r on
log10(cells): r rises linearly up to a breakpoint, then is flat (slope = 0).
The breakpoint is chosen by least squares over a grid; its 95% CI comes from
1,000 bootstrap resamples of strains. As a check that the right-hand segment
really is flat, a free two-slope model with the same breakpoint is also fitted
and its right-hand slope (with 95% CI) is reported. Fig 1D / S5 are unchanged.

```{r breakpoint, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.4}
set.seed(42)

# r = a + b * (min(x, c) - c): slope b for x < c, slope 0 for x >= c; a = plateau
fit_plateau <- function(x, y, grid) {
  rss <- vapply(grid, function(c) {
    sum(residuals(lm(y ~ I(pmin(x, c) - c)))^2)
  }, numeric(1))
  c_hat <- grid[which.min(rss)]
  list(c = c_hat, fit = lm(y ~ I(pmin(x, c_hat) - c_hat)), rss = min(rss))
}

bp_one_metric <- function(d, metric) {
  d <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[metric]]), .data[[metric]] > 0) %>%
    mutate(cells = .data[[metric]], lx = log10(cells))
  xs   <- sort(unique(d$lx))
  grid <- seq(xs[3], xs[length(xs) - 3], length.out = 200)  # >= 3 points each side

  pf <- fit_plateau(d$lx, d$r, grid)

  boot_c <- replicate(1000, {
    i <- sample(nrow(d), replace = TRUE)
    fit_plateau(d$lx[i], d$r[i], grid)$c
  })

  # free two-slope model at the same breakpoint: right slope = b1 + b2
  free <- lm(r ~ lx + I(pmax(lx - pf$c, 0)), data = d)
  b    <- coef(free); V <- vcov(free)
  right_slope <- b[2] + b[3]
  right_se    <- sqrt(V[2, 2] + V[3, 3] + 2 * V[2, 3])
  tcrit <- qt(0.975, df.residual(free))

  # does the plateau model beat a single straight line?
  lin <- lm(r ~ lx, data = d)

  stats <- tibble(
    metric            = metric,
    n_strains         = nrow(d),
    breakpoint_cells  = 10^pf$c,
    bp_ci_low         = 10^quantile(boot_c, 0.025),
    bp_ci_high        = 10^quantile(boot_c, 0.975),
    plateau_r         = coef(pf$fit)[1],
    left_slope_per_log10 = coef(pf$fit)[2],
    right_slope_free  = right_slope,
    right_slope_ci_low  = right_slope - tcrit * right_se,
    right_slope_ci_high = right_slope + tcrit * right_se,
    AIC_linear        = AIC(lin),                                                  # a, b, sigma
    AIC_plateau       = nrow(d) * (log(2 * pi * pf$rss / nrow(d)) + 1) + 2 * 4     # a, b, c, sigma
  )

  line_x <- seq(min(d$lx), max(d$lx), length.out = 300)
  curve  <- tibble(metric = metric, cells = 10^line_x,
                   r = coef(pf$fit)[1] + coef(pf$fit)[2] * (pmin(line_x, pf$c) - pf$c))

  list(d = d %>% mutate(metric = metric), stats = stats, curve = curve)
}

ypd_bp <- strain_df_all %>% filter(condition == "YPD")
bp <- lapply(c("min_cells", "mean_cells"), function(m) bp_one_metric(ypd_bp, m))

metric_lab <- c(min_cells  = "Min cells per strain (worse replicate)",
                mean_cells = "Mean cells per strain")

bp_pts <- bind_rows(lapply(bp, `[[`, "d")) %>%
  select(metric, strain, cells, `Same strain` = r, `Cross-strain` = cross_r) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`Same strain`, `Cross-strain`), names_to = "group", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Cross-strain", "Same strain")))
bp_curve <- bind_rows(lapply(bp, `[[`, "curve"))
bp_stats <- bind_rows(lapply(bp, `[[`, "stats"))

bp_lab <- bp_stats %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("breakpoint = %.0f cells\n(95%% CI %.0f-%.0f)\nslope after = %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
                       breakpoint_cells, bp_ci_low, bp_ci_high,
                       right_slope_free, right_slope_ci_low, right_slope_ci_high))

lab_fun <- as_labeller(metric_lab)

figS_breakpoint <- ggplot(bp_pts, aes(x = cells, y = r, color = group)) +
  geom_rect(data = bp_stats, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = bp_ci_low, xmax = bp_ci_high, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(data = bp_stats, aes(xintercept = breakpoint_cells),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_line(data = bp_curve, aes(x = cells, y = r), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "#2166AC", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = bp_lab, aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3, size = 2.4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Same strain" = "#2166AC", "Cross-strain" = "#D6604D"),
                     name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, labeller = lab_fun, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Cells assigned per strain (log10)",
       y = "Spearman r (YPD replicate 1 vs 2)") +
  pub_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

figS_breakpoint

knitr::kable(bp_stats, digits = 3,
             caption = "Linear-plateau fit of same-strain r on log10(cells) (YPD)")

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "FigS_reproducibility_breakpoint_YPD.pdf"), figS_breakpoint,
       width = 7, height = 3.4, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
write.csv(bp_stats, file.path(OUT_DIR, "FigS_reproducibility_breakpoint_YPD_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r figS6, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2}
s6_labels <- stats_all %>%
  filter(condition == "YPD") %>%
  mutate(lab = sprintf("median r = %.2f\n%.0f%% above 0.4",
                       median_gene_r, pct_gene_r_0.4))

# figS6 <- ggplot(filter(gene_df_all, !is.na(cor_category)),  # original: both conditions
figS6 <- ggplot(filter(gene_df_all, condition == "YPD", !is.na(cor_category)),
                aes(x = r, fill = cor_category)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.4, 0.7), linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = s6_labels, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cat_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Per-gene Spearman correlation across strains",
       y = "Number of genes") +
  pub_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

figS6

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "FigS6_per_gene_correlation.pdf"), figS6,
       width = 7, height = 3.2, units = "in")
```
